items.title: Anesthesia & Operation Theatre Technology- A Basic Prespective
items.subtitle: Specially designed for B.Sc B.Voc & M.Sc Anesthesia & Operation Theatre Technology Students
items.description: Anesthesia & Operation Theatre Technology: A Basic Perspective is a comprehensive academic textbook designed for students pursuing Diploma, B.Sc. and B.Voc. programmes in Operation Theatre Technology and Anesthesia Technology. The book is structured to provide students with a clear foundation in both operation theatre practices and basic anesthesia concepts, while connecting theoretical knowledge with clinical application.
